title: Akiyama Mizuki — Embroidery Enjoyment〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few weeks before Valentine's Day
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Pass it through here, tie it off and... Okay, done♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Shizuku, can you take a look at my embroidery?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course! Oh, this looks wonderful.
These beads you put on are so cute.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
This is such a complicated design.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I thought really hard about how to do this, and put a ton of effort into it♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You tied off each end so beautifully. I think it's perfect.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That means a lot coming from you, Shizuku♪
Alright, let's keep up the momentum! On to my other ribbons!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's all do our best to make sure our Valentine's Day gifts turn out really well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really do love working as a group like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not only do we get to chat while we work, having your friends praise you is a huge source of motivation!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
And being able to ask for help right away is really nice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for doing all this, Shizuku.
Not only did you help us come up with our designs, you've even set up dates which worked for all of us to keep getting together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You don't need to thank me...
I just wanted to embroider with all of you again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, but Asahina's running very late...
She said that she'd be right over after taking care of some class representative business...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Maybe it's taking longer than she'd hoped.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for running so late.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, that's okay. We know being a class representative is busy work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please, sit right here. And you can place your things over here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is it just me...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Or does she look more tired than usual...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What are your plans for today, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to continue working on the canvas embroidery I started last time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your design may take quite some time to complete, since it's a little complicated.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know. My goal is to get as much done as I can. Oh, but before I get started, I'm going to get myself a drink.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, then... I'll go with you and grab a refill!
Want me to do the same for your drinks, you two?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, but I'm okay for now.
Have fun, you two.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Isn't it great that this place has a drink station?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think I'll have some hot cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you want it hot, then why are you putting ice cubes in?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I can't drink it right away if it's too hot. I'm trying to get it down to just the right temperature.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Press the button and... There we go.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What should I get...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry if I'm getting the wrong idea, but are you feeling okay? You seem really tired for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What makes you say that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just a feeling. You seem kinda exhausted is all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I like working with the others like this, and I wanna hear their comments regarding my progress.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But if this is rough for you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't dislike coming here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see. Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's no cafe au lait coming out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? No, you're right!
It's not responding at all. Did it break or something?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll go ask the staff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Thanks.
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Her too, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Does that mean she also enjoys spending time here as a group like this?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If so, that'd make me really happy...)
